title: Bee-eater vs dragonfly
caption:
The bee-eater's rule: never swallow it while it can still fight back.

Bee-eaters are sit-and-wait hunters: they watch from a bare twig or wire, sally out to grab a flying insect, and bring it back to the perch to deal with it.

Source: Birds of the World (Cornell Lab), European Bee-eater; Combes et al. 2012, J. Exp. Biol.. Photos/video: Wikimedia Commons (credits on screen).
